summary: Fab edition of iaiops — semiconductor / display (panel TFT-LCD/OLED) fab equipment over SECS/GEM (SEMI E5 SECS-II, E30 GEM, E37 HSMS) plus OPC-UA for the equipment's internal control layer, with the cross-protocol brain (downtime root-cause copilot, OEE, asset inventory, data quality). Use when the task mentions SECS/GEM, SECS-II, HSMS, GEM host, wafer, panel, fab equipment, MES equipment interface, SVID, ECID, ALID, PPID / process program, recipe list, or a semiconductor / display fab tool. Read-first, MOC-gated writes.
